title: Smooth homotopy identity for a cylinder operator with the slice property (9)
statement: Let cyl_{N,k} : 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) be an arbitrary family of currents on univ satisfying (9) for cyl: for every X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ and every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) there is η ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with η(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) dt for all x, v and cyl(X)(ω) = X(η). Then (a) for N ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^N) with compact support and M(X) < ∞, β ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N+1}) and ρ₁, ρ₀ ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^N) with ρ_s(x)(v) = β(ι(s, x))(J ∘ v) for s ∈ {1, 0} and all x and (empty) v: cyl(X)(dβ) = X(ρ₁) − X(ρ₀); (b) for N, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞, M(∂X) < ∞, spt ∂X compact and boundaryMassOn ∂X univ < ∞, β ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) and ρ₁, ρ₀ ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N) with ρ_s(x)(v) = β(ι(s, x))(Jv_1, …, Jv_{k+1}) for s ∈ {1, 0} and all x, v: cyl(X)(dβ) = X(ρ₁) − X(ρ₀) − cyl(∂X)(β). Here d = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ.
